description: Create a commute comparison spreadsheet to help someone decide which neighborhood to move to. Open/create the spreadsheet at /home/ga/Documents/Spreadsheets/commute_comparison.xlsx. Create a comparison table with headers: Neighborhood, Primary Method, Time (min), Daily Cost, Monthly Cost, Backup Plan. Add data for three neighborhoods: Riverside (Bike+Train, 45 min, $4.50 daily), Oakmont (Direct Bus, 38 min, $3.50 daily), Downtown (Walk, 25 min, $0 daily). For Monthly Cost column, create formulas that calculate Daily Cost × 22 working days. Add backup plans for each neighborhood. Include a recommendation for best option. Save the spreadsheet (Ctrl+S).
